title: 3.7L Duratec Emission-Control Reference
introduction: For the 3.7L Duratec, this page points to the manual that contains the emission-control explanation. I use it as a signpost: system operation explains how the pieces work together, while component descriptions explain their individual jobs. The detailed teaching lives in the separate PC/ED manual; this page supplies no component list, diagnostic test or repair sequence.

edits.text: For system operation, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual, Section 1, Description and Operation.
edits.why: Use this referral for the explanation of how the emission-control system works. The referenced manual content is not included here.

edits.text: For component descriptions, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual, Section 1, Description and Operation.
